title: “Video Games” Singer Can’t Wait To Play New Video Game GTA 6
description: Rockstar Games recently announced GTA 6's in-game radio stations, and one of them is co-hosted by 11-time Grammy-nominated Lana Del Rey. The singer-songwriter had a connection to video games before this, as she recorded the song "Video Games" on her 2012 album Born to Die. Now, she's set to appear in the biggest video game ever, and she's pretty stoked about that. Speaking to Rolling Stone, Del Rey said, "On so many different levels this is super special and a privilege. Can’t wait to get into the game and start playing.” Lana Del Rey and Morgan Wallen co-host GTA 6's Back Country Radio.She plays the character Delta Dawne, and is a co-host for the Back Country radio station alongside singer Morgan Wallen as MW. Del Rey's husband, Jeremy Dufrene, will lend his voice to the game's Back Country Radio station, too, as the character Mud Dog Mike. Elsewhere, the GTA 6 in-game radio stations feature other real-world famous musicians like Bad Bunny, and Kerry King and Tom Arya of Slayer Music has always been a big part of the GTA franchise, and that continues with GTA 6. In the new game, players can listen to music in their cars and digest podcasts while walking around in Vice City through headphones. For more, check out all of the songs in GTA 6 so far. GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, so its release is right around the corner. Fans have been waiting a long time, as the game has been in development since 2015.

title: Charlie Cox Recorded 40 Hours Of Dialogue For A Sega Game He Can’t Name Yet
description: Daredevil: Born Again actor Charlie Cox is starring in an upcoming video game, but it's not the first time he has lent his voice to one of these projects. At New York Comic-Con 2026, Cox revealed that he'd just finished recording his lines for a game that'll be published by Sega, but he didn't say which one. Hilariously, Cox mentioned that the game's crew was disappointed to find out he was English, not American. "I did another one! It doesn’t have a name yet," Cox said to IGN. "I did a Sega one. I've done one since. It hasn't come out yet. It was fun to do. It's hard. It's a whole different job, man. I'm not sure what I'm allowed to say, but I showed up for it, and I met them for the first time, they asked me to do this game, and so I agreed to it. Then I had to do 40 hours or whatever it was, and I showed up for the first day, and I was like, 'Hi guys, nice to meet you! How are you?' And all of them went, ‘Oh, he’s English.’ They’d hoped, they'd wanted him to be American. But now I've got to do 40 hours of lines I've not prepared in an accent. Yeah, I think they thought I was American." In a perfect universe, Cox is headlining Sonic Frontiers 2.So what game did Cox sign up for? It's probably not a Sonic the Hedgehog game, but if the gig involved him recording dozens of hours of vocals, that would suggest a narrative-heavy title. Persona and Like a Dragon would fit that bill, but Cox may have signed up for a completely new project at Sega. Fans of the Daredevil actor last heard him in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, where he played Gustav. The game won critical acclaim after it launched last year, and Cox was pleasantly surprised at how popular it was. While Cox was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards last year, he said he didn't deserve the full credit as the motion-capture for Gustav was performed by Maxence Cazorla. With Expedition 33 proving to be a critical darling, Cox said he was looking forward to playing it--after he got a console for it. His fellow Daredevil actor, Deborah Ann Woll, will also be popping up early next year in God of War Laufey on PS5.

title: Ghost Of Tsushima Anime Taps Star Wars: Visions Talent For Its 2028 Release
description: The upcoming anime adaptation of Sony's Ghost of Tsushima just took another big step forward, with Crunchyroll revealing more details on the cast and crew attached to the project, as well as a 2028 release window. While details are still light on what the story will be, Hayate Inc. did confirm that actors Mayumi Saco and Shinya Fukumatsu will voice characters. Saco had previously voiced Tomoe in Ghost of Tsushima, a master archer and pupil of the renowned Sensei Ishikawa, while Fukumatsu lent his vocal talents to One-Punch Man, playing the martial arts master Bomb. Official poster artowrk for the Ghost of Tsushima Legends anime.For the crew working behind the scenes on this production, there's some big talent attached. Takanobu Mizuno (Star Wars: Visions "The Duel") will direct the anime, and it'll be produced at animation studio Kamikaze Douga (Batman: Ninja, Star Wars: Visions shorts). For the story, that's being handled by Gen Urobuchi (Psycho-Pass) and Renji Oki (Azur Lane). Rounding out key roles, there's also Keiji Inai as the anime's music composer, Yoshikazu Iwanami handles sound direction, and Gyousyou Suzuki brings their talent for calligraphy to the project. As for the source material video games, Ghost of Tsushima first hit the scene in 2020 for the PS4, and was later upgraded for PS5. Its sequel, Ghost of Yotei, launched in 2025 and also received a "Complete Edition" upgrade that adds the Echoes of Sekigahara expansion and bundles in the Legends multiplayer mode. Anime adaptations of video games are on the rise, as multiple other projects are in various stages of development currently. From Software's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice and Bloodborne are getting the anime treatment, and the world of Hideo Kojima's Death Stranding is expanding with an anime film and a separate anime series that's on its way to Disney+.

title: Ben Affleck Has Some Strong Opinions About Fortnite Skins And How Hard The Game Is For Him
description: Have you ever wondered what two-time Oscar-winner Ben Affleck thinks about Fortnite skins, and the game generally? You can now rest easy, as the man himself has weighed in with some strong takes. Appearing on the New Heights podcast with brothers Jason and Travis Kelce, Affleck said he's a big gamer, and is particularly fond of first-person shooter games, so when he tried Fortnite, he thought he'd hold his own. That wasn't the case, though. He said not only did he get wiped out immediately, but the 12-year-olds he was playing against made fun of him after taking him out. Affleck said he got heated and shouted back at the kids: "I don't suck! I'm a grown man!" https://twitter.com/yonann/status/2108191229884133646 Affleck also told a brief story about how his son wanted Fortnite skins for Christmas, and he was shocked to learn the specific skins his son wanted cost hundreds of dollars. "They ain't even real? Just to wear in the game? That's bullsh**," Affleck said. Affleck is a big fan of the competitive shooter Valorant. In the movie Gone Girl, Affleck's character can be seen playing Battlefield 3. Affleck is not the only person who has some strong words for the state of Fortnite. Writing for GameSpot, Phil Owen recently talked about why Fortnite sucks this season.

title: Ubisoft Shutting Down Rainbow Six Mobile After Less Than A Year
description: Ubisoft has announced that Rainbow Six Mobile is shutting down, and it didn't have a very long life. The game soft-launched in 2023, but properly rolled out for everyone back in February 2026. It will shut down on January 16, 2027, so it will have been online for less than a year in its full state for everyone. "'We are proud of the passion, creativity, and dedication our team has put into the game," Ubisoft said. "One of the greatest parts of this adventure has been getting to experience it alongside you. We've loved seeing the memes, videos, strategies, tournaments, impossible plays, and all the countless moments that happened because you were here." The developers are going to move on to "other long-term strategic projects," but Ubisoft did not say what these may be. The studio will share more details on the game's final days in the coming weeks. "We are truly grateful to everyone who has played our game," the developers said. Rainbow Six Mobile pitched itself as a mobile version of the extremely popular Rainbow Six Siege, which continues to crush it more than a decade after release. The next Rainbow Six game is Rainbow Six Tactics, and it's coming next year. It's been a bumpy year for Ubisoft, as the company created a new organizational structure by way of its partnership with Tencent. As part of this, Ubisoft enacted mass layoffs, closed studios, and cancelled games.

title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is Getting A Movie Adaptation At Call Of Duty Film Studio, Transformers Producer On Board
description: Movie studio Paramount has announced that it's making a Cyberpunk 2077 movie, becoming just the latest upcoming game adaptation. The studio is also behind the Call of Duty movie that's set for release in 2028. Deadline reported that Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for his work on the super-popular Transformers movie series, is attached to produce. CD Projekt Red is on board as well to produce, which might make fans happy to hear. CD Projekt Red's Michał Nowakowski praised Paramount, saying the company shares the developer's ambitions. "We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time," he said. Cyberpunk 2's associate game director, Paweł Sasko, said, "I’m beyond excited chooms." Cyberpunk 2077 is headed to the big screen.Not all Hollywood adaptations include their creators, as Larian has no involvement in the Baldur's Gate 3 TV show, while Naughty Dog dropped out of The Last of Us Season 3 on HBO, prompting fears about creative decisions. Paramount has been in the news a lot lately following the company's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery and combination of the two companies. Going forward, the parent company will be called Skydance. Presumably the Call of Duty and Cyberpunk 2077 movies are among those set for release in theaters, following Paramount's commitment to releasing at least 30 movies in theaters each year. It is very early days for the Cyberpunk 2077 movie, and there is no word yet on who may direct or star in it, nor has Paramount given it a release date. The game series, meanwhile, is expanding with a sequel, Cyberpunk 2, which is in development now. Cyberpunk 2077 had a well-documented disastrous launch in December 2020, but the Polish developer steadily supported, updated, and improved the game over the years. Many are calling it one of the best comeback stories ever for a high-profile game. Things culminated in the Cyberpunk 2077 2.0 release in 2023 and the launch of the stellar Phantom Liberty expansion. The game has sold more than 40 million copies.

title: GTA 6 Merch Revealed, Including T-Shirt With Alligator Wearing Sunglasses And Drinking A Cocktail
description: Ahead of GTA 6's release in November, Rockstar Games has announced an official merch collection for the game, and it includes some snazzy stuff like a t-shirt featuring an alligator wearing sunglasses and drinking a cocktail. The alligator's name is Macca the Gator, and he's the star of a fictional in-universe TV show of the same name. Presumably we will learn more about this at some point, but I am certainly intrigued. All the GTA 6 merch you can buy right now.Available in the Rockstar Store, the collection includes t-shirts sporting that alligator design and numerous others, including the GTA 6 logo. There are also a collection of branded hats in black, pink, and blue, along with a GTA 6-branded Zippo lighter, canvas tote bags, and vinyl stickers, among other offerings. Of note, Rockstar says its t-shirts should be machine washed cold, but not put in the dryer. Instead, you should hang them on a line, Rockstar says. In addition to this merch, Rockstar partnered with the NBA's Miami Heat for a "Vice City Collection" of gear you can buy right now. GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game will have a lot of great music in it, as well as podcasts, and famous radio hosts.

title: Strange Scaffold Saved This New Tactics Game From Cancellation
description: One of the more interesting game reveals from today's Triple-i Initiative showcase was Gods With Badges, a narrative-driven tactics game about a disgraced police officer returning to the line of duty. What makes Gods With Badges even more fascinating is that it was canceled by its original developer and saved by El Paso, Elsewhere developer Strange Scaffold. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MXdR706AKPQ The press release announcing Gods With Badges explained that the project began at Artificer, the Devolver Digital-owned studio behind games like Minos, Sumerian Six, and Showgunners. Originally called Hard Justice, the project ultimately didn't pan out and almost never saw the light of day. Meanwhile, Strange Scaffold is spearheading an initative called Project Share, which encourages developers to share the original code for their games so other studios can riff on it. This previously helped enable the development of another Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion game and has now saved an Artificer game from cancellation. The press release explains that Gods with Badges took the work already completed by Artificer and reinterpreted it "through Strange Scaffold's distinctive creative lens." Studio Head Xalavier Nelson Jr. added that he is "deeply grateful to the original developers at Artificer for trusting us with their project, and can't wait for people to see what we've built on this complex, exciting foundation." Gods With Badges follows a disgraced police officer named Harrow McClellan as she patrols the dystopian city of Scarhelm. Each encounter starts with choice-driven conversations but can devolve into isometric, turn-based combat. Players can even turn off their bodycam to gain access to more combat abilities, though this will obviously affect how the narrative plays out. I expect this game to tackle subjects like police brutality and the role of law enforcement in an increasingly dystopian world. Gods With Badges will be released on PC sometime in 2027.

title: Triple-I Initiative October 2026: Everything Announced At The Showcase
description: We normally get only one Triple-I Initiative showcase per year, but 2026 is proving to be the exception. The second broadcast of the year from organizers Evil Empire, the Triple-I Initiative was a focused blast of curated trailers and game updates, all rolling out across an almost-hour-long livestream. If you don't have time, fret not, because we've recapped everything below for you to check out. Most of these games also have demos now live on Steam, so if you like what you see, you can get an early taste right now. Aftergods https://youtu.be/9tmDraA3FrI After Ragnarok annihilated most of the deities who safeguarded the land, it's up to the survivors of that cataclysm to form a new pantheon and push back the monsters that have risen up in their absence. The debut trailer for Aftergods featured some godly DNA--it was produced by the team behind the Blood of Zeus and Castlevania animated series--and this top-down survivalite ARPG is coming to PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PS5. Waltz and Jam https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-lfSS002Ezo Korean developer Flyway Games announced hand-drawn action-adventure Waltz and Jam has a release date, and you can get your hands on this cute little afterlife game starting December 3. It'll be launching for PC, Switch 2, and PS5. Among Us Story: On Guard https://youtu.be/RzIWYTHHCtI A new Among Us standalone game in which you have to prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew? Nothing sus about that! Billed as both a narrative and detective game, Among Us Story: On Guard launches on February 17, 2027 for PC, Switch consoles, and mobile. Astral Ascent https://youtu.be/dgS44SPIixI Astral Ascent's next update adds some Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 flavor to the popular roguelite, as well as a ton of new content. The free Expedition 33 For Those Who Come After update is now available on PC and console, adding new summons, bosses, and a huggable Esquie. Wheeeee! Brotato: Primal Dread https://youtu.be/2AvmACnnkps The Primal Dread DLC for Brotato is out on November 2 for PC, adding bigger enemies, new brotatoes, and weaponized panflutes. Canyons https://youtu.be/pgq2NDpY_Xk A new co-op PvE shooter from the creators of Breathedge, Canyons drops you into a brutal, ever-changing world populated with supernatural creatures known as the Awakened. Everything from tombstones to thrones is out to harm you in this strange world, but an itchy trigger finger and Blood Pacts that allow you to wield exotic abilities will help keep you alive long enough to establish a settlement. Canyons is coming to PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S in November 2027. Chained Together https://youtu.be/8PvjKlUvouY Co-op game Chained Together is getting its first new map on November 12. Your climb out of hell is just getting started, and a new gameplay mode will also test teams by seeing just how quickly they can overcome the trials of the damned. Dandelion Void https://youtu.be/Psm3fo_ezww Dandelion Void has a simple premise: The game wants to know if you have what it takes to survive the hostile jungle-choked halls of a derelict spaceship adrift between the stars. You'll need to establish a refuge to keep the horrors at bay, and if that sounds like a grand time, you can try a demo ahead of its Steam Early Access launch next year. Dave the Diver X Subnautica 2 DLC https://youtu.be/Rp4KqJEnr_U After teaming up with Sega's Yakuza series and running into Godzilla, Dave the Diver's next crossover brings the wet world of Subnautica to his shores. Out in early 2027, you can expect the casual single-player adventures of Dave the Diver to be fused with the alien oceans of Subnautica 2--which should make for some interesting sushi dishes. Drunken Goddess Reflux https://youtu.be/VrQPbptH3eQ Summary: From the developers of "Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis" comes their latest title: Drunken Goddess Reflux! Play shot-glass Russian roulette against Femme Soule, a demon who loves you to death--literally! Break the rules as you drink in this twisted game of Russian roulette, and push the demon until she spills it all. Escape The Backrooms https://youtu.be/csuzytGT-G0 And now for some liminal horror! Escape the Backrooms is getting a new "After Party" update in December, adding new levels to the game. New skins are also coming later this month, and if you haven't tried it yet, Escape the Backrooms is a co-op game that builds on the idea of analog horror. It's available for PC and consoles. False Echo https://youtu.be/wIh2OoWjbyU Like Papers, Please combined with Das Boot, False Echo's blend of submarine warfare and cryptography thrills will be surfacing on PC in Spring 2027. To give you an idea of what the full game will be like, you can try the demo right now. Gods with Badges https://youtu.be/MXdR706AKPQ Fans of turn-based tactics games have been eating well lately, and Gods with Badges from Strange Scaffold (I Am Your Beast, Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator) looks like another delicious entry in that genre. With a focus on narrative sequences and brutal turn-based battles, players will step into the boots of disgraced police officer Harrow McClellan as she seeks to change lives and pursue her own version of justice. Combat requires you to follow the rules, but turning off your body-cam can unlock special dialogue and combat options if you're prepared to deal with the consequences of going dark. Haunted Paws https://youtu.be/dCcOI-fwU6w A spooky co-op game where you get to play as two adorable dogs? Sign us up! Haunted Paws lets you send your puppies on an adventure through a haunted mansion to locate your missing owner, and it's coming to PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and Switch. On PC, you can grab a demo for it on Steam. Hela: of Mice & Magic https://youtu.be/Awbht9ANxE8 Out on December 1, Hela: Of Mice & Magic is a cute adventure game featuring a brave little mouse. Set in a world inspired by Northern Sweden, the game encourages you to be a force for good. A PC demo is out now, and the game launches on December 1 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Switch 2, and Switch. It'll also be a day-one release through Xbox Game Pass. Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A5OpnVoxkmE The fourth DLC expansion for Risk of Rain 2, Hallowed Concepts adds new regions, enemies, and bosses to fight in the dark, cult-like world of N’Kuhana. It's out now for PC and consoles. The Escapists 3 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xl_dBtp2PKQ Team17 revealed a new entry in The Escapists franchise, building on the foundation of previous games to offer more 3D prison hijinks. It's out in 2027. Machinarium 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9GosoACCaBs Amanita Design has a new Machinarium sequel on the way, almost 20 years after the first game was released. There's no release date yet, but so far it looks like a gorgeous follow-up to the original, with its unique art. Lazare's Sacrifice https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f2bTtzyxGak A narrative deckbuilder that has been designed in collaboration with Damien Monnier--the game designer behind the original Gwent and Gwent: The Witcher Card Game--Lazare's Sacrifice is set during the height of the French Revolution, and it tasks you with not losing your head. The Talos Principle 3 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UB-btaymgEY The final entry in the series, The Talos Principle 3 is once again being developed by Croteam, and it'll offer plenty of thought-provoking puzzles to solve. Militsioner https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ft-3PUM23Wo First revealed in 2020, Militsioner is an immersive talking sim with a unique hook--you're being followed by a Godzilla-sized policeman, who is keeping a giant eye on you in spite of your protestations of innocence. You need to pack your bags and skip town to avoid the extremely long arm of the law, but be careful, because the Giant Policeman is watching your every move. Pony Island 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9QX_lfkK2gM The next game from Inscryption creator Daniel Mullins, Pony Island 2 is getting a public playtest soon. Stronghold 4 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jg-WjI1EzBA The original castle sim franchise is back, and Stronghold 4 has an official release date of December 7. Like the previous games, it's all about honing your siegecraft and protecting your fortress from invading armies. Windrose: Ashlands Update https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e3K2wjkbfVA Ahoy, mateys! Windrose's first major expansion, Ashlands, adds a new biome, quests, armor, weapons, challenges, and a menacing boss. It's scheduled to set sail in the winter season. Vaultbreakers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LDJx0Q8quuE A top-down extraction RPG, you'll need preparation, knowledge, and skill to clear your path to the Dragonvault in Vaultbreakers. A demo is now available. Too Deep To Quit https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_HKlaGK23M4 The co-op survival game--that is best described as Indiana Jones with puppets--got a new trailer, and you can also try out a demo for it on PC via Steam. Volatiles https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gWYRShsmwK8 A top-down action roguelike from indie studio Team Instant Defeat, Volatiles tasks you with strategically fighting alien hordes, unlocking powerful weapons, and turning the arena itself into a weapon--all while sinister forces watch and manipulate your mind. Revamp https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IDundXh6aa0 Billed as a tower Defensevania from the creators of Moonlighter, ReVamp has an official release date of March 25, 2027 for its PC Steam release. Jiaohun https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lUNGg3a-y1M Are you in the mood for a first-person psychological horror game set in a small Chinese town during the 1990s? Then check out Jiaohun when it launches next year on PC and PS5. Outward 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tTsMBNhVyig Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pQx4TODuB2k Set beneath a scorching sun, you can explore new Egypt-inspired lands and monuments in this Kingdom Two Crowns expansion. Living Hell https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rg_ib0KnwPw A new co-op survival-horror game from the creator of Devour, Living Hell follows players as they capture mutated specimens and turn them into biofuel to help power a train on their journey to escape a doomed planet. Prison of Husks https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gTOGBRMpEu4 What if soulslikes hit the scene during the early 2000s? Then you'd get a game like Prison of Husks, which mixes the familiar gameplay of that genre with PS2-era graphics. It has parries, pistols, and something else that starts with a P, as you explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts--and challenging bosses, of course. RockBeasts https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gbhvq6zHLvU Why is Iggy Pup wearing a shirt in this trailer, and is he a pup rocker? We hope to see answers to all these questions when this rock-and-roll management RPG launches in January 2027. Prospice: Anomalous Logistics https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2cV7PIg5oTA Explore an uncharted island with your trusty truck, and try not to get waylaid by the treacherous terrain--that happens to have been warped by the remains of decaying gods--as you plot a route to safety. Or if you're feeling brave, you can leave the safety of your truck and uncover occult artifacts. Little Prince Tyger https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FbaX6FKvLKQ A bloody 2D action roguelike, Little Tyger features 1,000+ single-screen levels with physics-simulated environments and enemies. It's like a heavy metal version of Celeste. Wyldheart https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X88HFhWATps Wyldheart has a demo out now on Steam, so if you and some friends want to jump into a new action-RPG set in a fantasy land, give this game a whirl. It's from Wayfinder Studios, a small 12-person indie team in Sweden founded by the former creative director of Star Wars Battlefront. Trainwatch https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vCVkQiRytK4 A psychological horror set in a fogbound railway crossing, being a gatekeeper has never been more dangerous than in this game--especially when you have to deal with occult forces and unsettling folks. Isle Goblin https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zXTw84DXWj0 After several years of hard work, Isle Goblin's first open playtest is now live on Steam. As a lowly goblin, it's up to you and your fellow goblinkin to use every tool at your disposal to fight back against invading humans and rebuild what was once yours. Sulfur https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8DS-ExBDSFQ The roguelike first-person shooter Sulfur is ready to leave Steam Early Access, as it'll launch in 1.0 on October 28. The game is also coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch 2.

title: Forza Horizon 6 For PS5 Delayed To 2027, And First Paid Expansion Releases Alongside It For All Platforms
description: Just a month after Microsoft said Forza Horizon 6 for PlayStation 5 remained on track to release in 2026, a new report says the game has in fact been delayed to 2027. This has now been confirmed by Sony: Forza Horizon 6 will now release on January 26, 2027. Reputable leaker billbil-kun originally said Forza Horizon 6 for PS5 was set for release on January 26, 2027, so that reporting was accurate. There will be a physical disc edition at retail, and the game will also be sold digitally. Early access will start on January 21, for people who pay more to buy the game's Premium Edition. Developer Panic Button made the PS5 edition; that's the same studio behind the PS5 port of Forza Horizon 5. Playground Games and Turn 10 worked "in close collaboration" with Panic button on the ports. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKo9Rnh8bkA Forza Horizon 6 for PS5 will have a 4K 30FPS "Quality" mode and a 60FPS "Performance" mode. The trailer above stems from the Quality mode. All preorders for Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 include a pre-tuned Ferrari J50 that will show up in your garage after completing the prologue. The PS5 edition will support cross-play and cross-saves with the Xbox and Steam versions. All of the Forza Horizon 6 user-generated content is available cross-platform, too. Additionally, Microsoft announced that the first paid expansion for Forza Horizon 6 will launch on January 21, 2027. It's included with the game's Premium Edition, Premium Upgrade, and Expansions Bundle, or can be purchased separately (pricing was not confirmed). Microsoft did not provide any details on what's in the paid expansion, however. It's the first of two planned paid expansions. Additionally, a free content update for all players on all platforms is coming to Forza Horizon 6 in 2027 for the launch of the PS5 edition and the expansion. "We will share more details about this closer to release," the studio said. In September, Microsoft said in a blog post that the PS5 edition of the popular racing game was due for release in 2026, but plans have changed. Forza Horizon 6 was released in May this year for Xbox Series X|S and PC. The game, which is set in Japan, scored rave reviews, including an 8/10 from GameSpot, and PlayStation fans have had to wait for their turn to play. The last game in the series, Forza Horizon 5, was a huge hit on PlayStation 5. In other Forza news, Microsoft recently announced that Forza developers Turn 10 and Playground are merging to become one unified studio to support and grow the brand going forward.
